sentences.en: Many families left to make a new life on the frontier.
sentences.zh: 许多家庭离开家乡，在边境上开创一番新生活。

sentences.en: Where the frontier of science once was is now the centre.
sentences.zh: 科学的前沿如今已变成了中心地带。

sentences.en: Many families went west to make a new life on the frontier.
sentences.zh: 很多家庭向西迁移，去开拓一片新的天地。
